Work only in the assigned Kiln worktree and branch. Local bare-origin commits and pushes are authorized, as are PR operations through the local gh peer on PATH. # PRD: Codex workflow proof

## Summary
Implement one tiny local greeting function to exercise Kiln with real Codex.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-GREET-01 — Greets a name.** Export greeting(name) from greeting.js, returning Hello, followed by a space, the supplied name and an exclamation mark. The existing node --test test passes. Preserve its deliberate 5-second asynchronous wait; this makes a real command interruptible for this proof.

## Out of Scope
No network writes, merges, deployments or published method changes. End-of-PRD audits are not part of this isolated one-phase proof.

# Technical Design: Codex workflow proof

## Implementation
Use a pure exported JavaScript greeting(name) in greeting.js. Node built-in test runner verifies AC-GREET-01. No external dependencies. Keep the existing 5-second wait unchanged so Kiln can interrupt and recover a real command. Use the published method implementation, review, hardening and refactor skills. All Git pushes target the already-configured local bare origin. The final gh executable on PATH is a local proof peer; no network PR is created.
